# Copilot Instructions for La Bonne Alternance

## Project Overview

**La Bonne Alternance (LBA)** is a French government platform for finding apprenticeship training and job opportunities, serving job seekers, employers and training centers (website, public API, widget).

**Tech Stack**: Node.js >= 26 (`.node-version`), Yarn 3, TypeScript 7, Next.js 16 (UI), Fastify 5 (server), MongoDB with mongot (`$search`), Zod 4, Biome 2, Vitest, Playwright (`ui/e2e`), Sentry
**Architecture**: monorepo with 3 workspaces — `server` (API, jobs, crons), `ui` (Next.js App Router, MUI + react-dsfr), `shared` (Zod models and route schemas, used by both)

## Architecture Principles to Enforce

These apply when generating code **and** when reviewing it — flag violations even where no lint/CI rule currently checks for them.

**Deep Modules**: a module should expose a simple interface that hides significant implementation complexity (Ousterhout, *A Philosophy of Software Design*). Avoid shallow modules — wrappers whose interface is nearly as complex as their implementation. When a service or component grows and mixes several responsibilities, extract a deep module with a narrow interface rather than splitting it into small interdependent files.

**File naming**: kebab-case for all `.ts` files (services, hooks, utils, jobs, models); PascalCase unchanged for `.tsx` components, except Next.js App Router reserved filenames (`page.tsx`, `layout.tsx`, `loading.tsx`, `error.tsx`, `not-found.tsx`, `template.tsx`, `default.tsx`), which keep Next's own lowercase convention. Not yet enforced by Biome (no naming rule in `biome.json`) — apply and flag in review regardless.

**Next.js — Cache Components & Partial Prefetching**: `cacheComponents: true` and `partialPrefetching: true` are enabled globally in `ui/next.config.mjs`. For dynamic routes/fetches, use `"use cache: private"` with `cacheTag()` and `cacheLife({ revalidate })` — never `"use cache"` (plain) once `headers()`/session cookies are read, and never reintroduce `export const instant = false` (a completed migration flag). `<Activity>` pitfall: components stay mounted across back-navigation instead of remounting, so any state derived from an initial prop (`useState(initialProp)`) needs an explicit `useEffect(() => setState(prop), [prop])` to resync — check for this on every page/component with prop-derived initial state.

**Zod v4**: use top-level validators (`z.email()`, not `z.string().email()`); use `z.codec(input, output, { decode, encode })` instead of `.transform()` for two-way schemas; `AnyZodObject`/`ZodTypeAny` are gone, use `z.ZodObject<any>`/`z.ZodType`.

**Comments**: no comment by default. Write one only for what the code cannot say: a decision and its reason, an external constraint (a tool limit, an API behavior), a non-obvious business rule, or deliberately counter-intuitive behavior. Describe the code as it is, not its history (no "no longer", "previously", "now", no debugging narrative) — history belongs in the commit or PR. Explain each thing in one place and point to it elsewhere with a one-line reference (`cf. buildSortStage`). Aim for 1–3 lines; a longer block must carry information found nowhere else. Cite only stable references (issue/PR number, symbol name), never internal milestones ("recette #3"). When renaming or moving a symbol, search for comments that mention it. In review, flag comments that paraphrase the code, duplicate an explanation, or reference a symbol that no longer exists.

**UI**: DSFR icons first (`fr-icon-*`); check react-dsfr typings at https://github.com/codegouvfr/react-dsfr/tree/main/src.

## Known Pitfalls

Flag these in review as well.

- **`yarn cli` runs `server/dist`, not the sources** (`node dist/index.js`). After changing `shared` or a model, rebuild `shared` then `server` before running a CLI command.
- **MongoDB schema validator** is `error` outside production and `warn` in production (`configureDbSchemaValidation` in `server/src/common/utils/mongodb-utils.ts`). A new required field breaks every partial update in recette until it is backfilled: add it as optional first. Migrations that rewrite documents pass `bypassDocumentValidation: true`.
- **job-processor crons**: do not set `concurrency: { mode: "exclusive" }` on a frequent cron — one slot out of two is lost (measured in production, see `server/src/jobs/jobs.ts`).
- **`sanitizeTextField(null)` returns `""`**, which silently disables any `??` downstream. Use `||`, or `sanitizeNullableTextField` (`format-text-fields-jobs-partners.ts`) to keep `null`.
- **mongot / `$search`**: `exists` also matches fields set to `null` — use a `range` clause instead. Query limits (`maxClauseCount`) and the transient-cancellation retry are documented in `server/src/services/search/`; design docs in `docs/mongodb/`.

## Autonomous Agent Files — Do Not Touch

`ui/AGENTS.md` and `ui/CLAUDE.md` are auto-generated by `next dev` (see `node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/generate-agent-files.js`). Leave them alone — do not merge their content elsewhere or edit them. The root `CLAUDE.md` is maintained by hand and mirrors the conventions and pitfalls above.

## Pull Requests & Commits

- **Commits**: Conventional Commits, enforced by commitlint (`.husky/commitlint.config.js`, extends `@commitlint/config-conventional`). Types: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `chore`, `ci`, `build`, `revert`.
- **PR title**: `type: subject (#XXX)`, where `XXX` is the GitHub issue number; drop the suffix when no issue is linked. `pr-title-check.yml` only accepts the types `fix`, `feat`, `refactor`, `chore` and `docs` (`.github/pr-title-checker-config.json`). A scope is optional and names a workspace (`chore(ui): …`), never the issue — the issue number belongs in the title suffix and in `Closes #XXX`.
- **PR description**: whenever you create or update one (Copilot Summary, generated description, `@copilot` mention), take the issue number from the title and start the description with `Closes #XXX`. Never omit it. Template:

  ```
  Closes #XXX

  ## Changes

  - ...

  ## Testing

  - ...
  ```

- PRs opened with Claude Code go through the `pull-request-lba` skill, which also syncs the linked issue's status in the "La bonne alternance" GitHub Project.

## Setup, Build & Test

### Prerequisites

Node (version in `.node-version`), Yarn (enforced by `packageManager`), Docker. `yarn setup` needs GPG keys for vault access (not needed for code changes); it also writes the local mongot password (`.infra/local/mongot_password`).

### Commands

```bash
yarn install --immutable
yarn typecheck                  # tsc -b on ui, server and shared
yarn check:fix                  # Biome lint + format with fixes (yarn check:ci in CI)
yarn services:start             # Docker services: mongodb, mongot, clamav, smtp
yarn setup:mongodb              # initialize the local replica set
yarn test <path>                # Vitest (yarn test:ci = single run, yarn test:watch)
yarn build                      # all workspaces, sequentially (yarn foreach:seq)
yarn dev                        # services + server (5001) + ui (3000)
yarn cli <command>              # jobs and migrations, from server/dist
yarn migration:create -d <description>
yarn migrations:status / yarn migrations:up
yarn knip                       # unused files/exports (baseline in docs/developpement/knip.md)
```

After any dependency bump: `yarn install` then `yarn dedupe --strategy highest` (CI runs `yarn dedupe --check`).

### Notes

- **Biome** (`biome.json`) replaces ESLint and Prettier: 2-space indent, 180-char lines, LF. Enforced rules include `noUnusedVariables` (prefix unused vars with `_`), `noFloatingPromises`, `useExhaustiveSwitchCases`, `useImportType`.
- **Build**: server bundled with `tsup`, UI with Next.js standalone output. The UI `prebuild` runs `react-dsfr update-icons` and `only-include-used-components`. `shared` must be built before server/ui consume it.
- **Tests** need MongoDB (and mongot for search tests) running locally. Each Vitest worker gets its own database (`server/tests/utils/mongo.test.utils.ts`); `useMongo` hooks run sequentially (`sequence.hooks: "stack"`). Test files: `**/*.test.ts` (server), `**/*.test.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)` (UI). Setup: `server/tests/utils/setup.ts`, `ui/tests/setup.ts`.
- **Common failures**: missing-module type errors → `yarn workspace shared build` then `yarn typecheck`; MongoDB connection errors → `yarn services:start` and `yarn setup:mongodb`; missing icons at build → `cd ui && yarn prebuild`.

## CI/CD (`.github/workflows/`)

- `ci.yml` is a reusable workflow (`workflow_call`), run by `preview.yml` on open PRs, `merge_queue.yml` on the merge queue and `release.yml` on push. Steps: `npm-packages-check` (`mna-npm-check`), then `yarn install --immutable`, `yarn dedupe --check`, `yarn typecheck`, `yarn check:ci`, MongoDB + mongot, `yarn test:ci`. Timeout 10 min. CI does **not** run `yarn build`.
- `pr-title-check.yml`: PR title format. `perf_budget.yml`: UI bundle size budget.
- `preview.yml` / `deploy_preview.yml` / `preview_cleanup.yml`: preview environments — a PR comment containing 🚀 deploys `https://<PR>.labonnealternance-preview.apprentissage.beta.gouv.fr/`.
- `release.yml`: semantic-release (`yarn release`), then deployment through the reusable `_deploy.yml`. `codeql.yml`: security scanning.
- Pre-commit (`.husky/pre-commit`): `yarn lint-staged` (Biome on staged sources, `yarn dedupe` on `yarn.lock`), `preventSensibleFilesCommit.sh`, `yarn gitleaks:check`.

## Project Structure

```
server/src/
  http/controllers/   # API handlers (OpenAPI generated from Zod schemas via @fastify/swagger)
  services/           # business logic
  jobs/               # background jobs, crons (jobs.ts), CLI commands
  common/apis/        # external API clients
  common/utils/       # utilities
  migrations/         # database migrations
  security/           # auth & authorization
server/tests/         # test utilities and integration tests
ui/
  app/                # App Router: (candidat), (espace-pro), (editorial)…
  components/ services/ utils/ context/ theme/
  e2e/                # Playwright
shared/src/
  models/ routes/ constants/ helpers/ utils/
docs/                 # developpement/, infrastructure/, mongodb/
.infra/               # infrastructure & local configs (.infra/local/mongod.conf)
.bin/                 # mna CLI (setup, seed, deploy)
_temp/                # gitignored: handoff notes and work plans
```

Local services (`docker-compose.yml`): `mongodb` (replica set, 27017, 5 GB limit, `mongo_keyfile` copied by `.infra/local/Dockerfile.mongod`), `mongot` (`$search`), `clamav` (3310, slow first start), `smtp` (Mailpit, 1025 / UI 8025).

## Security

- Validate every external input with Zod; sanitize user-provided HTML server-side with `sanitize-html`.
- Secrets come from the vault/environment, never hardcoded; gitleaks runs on every commit.
- `TODO_SECURITY_FIX` comments mark known issues — do not copy the pattern they flag.

## When Instructions Are Incomplete

Trust these instructions first; search the codebase only when a command fails, information is missing, or an error suggests the instructions are outdated — and report the outdated part.
